method: 128 fresh team-pair clusters, two outcome repeats, side-swapped; paired cluster bootstrap. Decision traces enabled.
interpretation: This independent traced screen does not reproduce the Round522 first-five intervention lift. The agent is already behind in the first post-turn snapshots among losses, but outcome-stratified traces are descriptive rather than causal. The broad confidence interval and variation across fresh samples require more paired evidence before selecting a training target.
